name: lookup_patient
description: Confirm the identity of the member on this call, optionally against their date of birth, before discussing appointment details. Always resolves the authenticated member - it cannot look up another member ID.

dob.description: Date of birth YYYY-MM-DD, optional additional verification

name: get_upcoming_appointments
description: List the upcoming scheduled appointments for the member on this call. Takes no arguments - the member is bound from the authenticated session, not passed in.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Reschedule one of this member's existing appointments to a new date/time, subject to reschedule-eligibility policy (e.g. same-day changes are not self-service eligible). Only appointments belonging to the member on this call can be changed.

new_datetime.description: New ISO-8601 date-time for the appointment

name: get_provider_info
description: Look up a provider's specialty, network status, and location by provider ID. Directory data, not member-scoped.
